title: Approvals
reasonHint: Explain the changes needed, from 1 to 1000 characters.
submitEffectOwner: Submitting locks version {version}. {owner} approves first, then {tenant} accepts.
approveEffect: Approving sends version {version} to {tenant} for acceptance. This version cannot be edited; to change terms, request changes with a reason and the manager will create a revised contract.
acceptEffect: Accepting concludes the contract on version {version}.
returnEffect: Requesting changes cancels this contract. The manager will review your reason and create a revised contract.
withdrawEffect: Withdrawing cancels version {version} and voids its approvals. To change terms, the manager creates a revised contract.
cancelEffect: Cancelling closes draft version {version}. The manager can then create a revised contract.
reviseEffect: This creates a new draft linked to this contract. The manager edits the draft and submits it for fresh approvals.
proof: Three different people decided on the same version hash, each in their own signed-in session. No one-time code or emailed link carried an approval. Each decision is a hash-chained audit event.
proofTwo: Two different people decided on the same version hash, each in their own signed-in session. No one-time code or emailed link carried an approval. Each decision is a hash-chained audit event.
proofPending: Recorded decisions refer to the version hash shown. The contract concludes when all required people have approved or accepted.
